title: Canonical form of a circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs whose output vertex is the last vertex, so that its output index plus one equals its size. Then the circuit obtained by canonicalizing $C$ has, at each gate, its input indices in strictly increasing order, and its output vertex is the last vertex.
hypotheses_covered: The output index of $C$ plus one equals its size
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the operation of canonicalizing a circuit, so the nature of the resulting circuit cannot be determined from the given formal snippet.
